newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian police detain 550 ahead of Miss World.
newsitem.headline: Indian police detain 550 ahead of Miss World.

text.p: Indian police said on Saturday they have detained around 550 activists to head off potential trouble at the Miss World beauty pageant, but the hunt was still on for a squad of protesters threatening suicide.

Bangalore police commissioner S.C. Burman said he had issued orders for officers to pick up Kinay Narayana Shashikala, who has threatened 15 women will burn themselves alive to protest the beauty show being held on Saturday evening in this southern Indian city.
Police began mass detentions as a preventive step on Friday and by Saturday morning more than 100 right-wing Hindu nationalists, leftists and various other militants had been rounded up.

Burman said members of a front organisation for the Peoples War Group (PWG), a Naxalite Maoist rebel movement that has killed several policemen in the neighbouring state of Andhra Pradesh, had also been put under guard.
"All the people arrested today have been arrested for violating prohibitory orders," Burman told reporters.

More than 10,000 police and paramilitary personnel are patrolling Bangalore to ensure the Miss World contest passes off smoothly. The three-hour Miss World finale starts at 2115 local (1545 GMT) and the winner will be crowned shortly before midnight (1830 GMT).
